name: @pie527645-cloud/otel-span-audit
description: Static TypeScript/JavaScript AST auditor for OpenTelemetry span lifecycle leaks (startSpan, startActiveSpan) and catch-block exception status hygiene.
author: pie527645-cloud

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/normalize-lf.mjs
scripts.test: node --test dist-test/test/otl001.test.js dist-test/test/otl002.test.js dist-test/test/otl003.test.js dist-test/test/golden.test.js dist-test/test/formatters.test.js dist-test/test/pathGuard.test.js dist-test/test/cli.test.js
